I jotted down a question for my next appointment.

A little sorting now saves a search later.
I tidied a junk drawer that had been bothering me.
Small, but satisfying to finally deal with.
I tried a new stretch routine for five minutes.
A short trial is a low-stakes way to test something new.
I set out vitamins for the week in a organizer.
Sorting it out ahead of time saves a decision each morning.
I looked up a recipe for a lighter dinner.
Planning ahead can simplify the evening.
I updated a fitness app with a new goal.
Adjusting a target can keep it feeling realistic.
I have a Thursday neurology exam where the doctor needs to test my baseline coordination and strength without heat interference.

I checked in with a sibling about a shared errand.
Checking in on logistics is its own small task.
I moved a plant to get more morning light.

I wiped down the kitchen counters after cooking.
A quick reset can make the next meal easier.
I skimmed a wellness article shared by a coworker.
Passive reading can still be useful context.

I reviewed a grocery list for the week.

A friend invites me to a hot outdoor festival this week.
Worth weighing that against what else is already on the calendar.
